purpose.source_body: Existing source collider in Godot XYZ metres; all detail levels remain inside it.
purpose.post_body: Existing compact Green Junction collider; two visible branches retain the native shared top cable anchor.
purpose.port_height: Existing central cable anchor at 1.18 m for both native output spans.
purpose.lod_triangles: Near/mid/far reduction targets; record achieved counts and inspect silhouette without waiving physical checks.
purpose.scar: 6 mm half-core, 22 mm damaged grain and up to 3 mm recess. Green light is presentation, not poison or terrain growth.
purpose.paths: A shared front-grain stem divides into two fading branches; RGBA stores core, damage, progress and branch identity.
purpose.period_seconds: 4.2-second natural travelling pulse splits at 42% of the route. The junction uses real counter events instead.
purpose.minimum_light: 25% ambient floor keeps the narrow natural scar visible between crests.
purpose.peak_emission: 3.7 peak, no bloom, checked in both renderers and shade/day.
purpose.source_ready_gain: Subdued ready-source pulse, zero after exhaustion or during blocked reformation.
purpose.source_work_gain: Brighter after actual manual extraction progress, without inventing a work timer.
purpose.claim_gain: Quiet exposed-mineral light while native claim or carried count is positive.
purpose.camera_fov: 48-degree isolated review camera; not player-camera tuning.
purpose.passage_seconds: 1.05-second passage only when the native Green counter increases. Each physically clear output shows its request even if that receiver refuses work.
purpose.resin: New cut faces are inferred cloudy olive resin with 0.36 roughness, blended over 12 mm of distance from the sampled original surface; outer bark and attached scars remain.
